confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Far North Queensland tourism pricing for July (peak dry-season) and no live listings were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident; accommodation anchors are lower confidence because seasonal rates vary widely. The FX value was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page, and the page itself was not read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional Queensland tourist towns near Cairns, scaled for Port Douglas's higher peak-season accommodation and dining prices.
